identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Bempegaldesleukin (NKTR-214: BEMPEG) in Combination With Nivolumab Compared With the Investigator's Choice of a Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor (TKI) Therapy (Either Sunitinib or Cabozantinib Monotherapy) for Advanced Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Randomized Open Label Study to Compare NKTR-214 Combined With Nivolumab to the Investigator's Choice of Sunitinib or Cabozantinib in Patients With Previously Untreated Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma

armGroups.label: Combination of bempegaldesleukin + nivolumab
armGroups.description: Patients in Arm A will receive bempegaldesleukin in combination with nivolumab.

armGroups.label: sunitinib or cabozantinib
armGroups.description: Patients in Arm B will receive the Investigator's choice of either one of two treatment options.
